title: Tensions Rise as Conflict Between US and Iran Spreads Across the Middle East
subtitle: Recent military strikes in Iraq and Iran have created a dangerous new phase in the regional conflict.

summary.en: The United States and Iran have returned to active fighting after a brief pause in violence. US forces recently launched a major wave of strikes against Iranian military targets. Meanwhile, Iraq has expressed anger over joint US-Saudi attacks on its soil. These events have made international efforts to find a peaceful solution much harder. Experts warn that the situation is now entering a very unpredictable and dangerous period.
summary.zh: 美國與伊朗在短暫的暴力平息後，已恢復積極交戰。美軍近期對伊朗軍事目標發動了一波重大空襲。與此同時，伊拉克對美沙兩國在其領土上的聯合攻擊表示憤怒。這些事件使得國際社會尋求和平解決方案的努力變得更加困難。專家警告，局勢目前正進入一個極度不可預測且危險的時期。

paragraphs.en: The conflict between the United States and Iran has entered a new and dangerous phase this week. After a short period of relative calm, the two countries have returned to a series of back-and-forth military attacks. This escalation has moved the region into what many experts call “uncharted territory,” as the fighting spreads across several borders and threatens to become a wider regional war.
paragraphs.zh: 美國與伊朗之間的衝突本週進入了一個嶄新且危險的階段。在經歷短暫的相對平靜後，兩國又回到了軍事攻擊的相互報復循環。這種升級已將該地區推向許多專家所稱的「未知領域」，因為戰火正蔓延至多個邊境，並有演變成更廣泛區域戰爭的風險。

paragraphs.en: The latest violence began after the United States carried out a heavy wave of strikes against Iran. According to US Central Command, these attacks targeted military command centers, as well as missile and drone facilities belonging to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). The US military stated that these actions were necessary to reduce the threats posed by Iran to American forces, commercial ships, and neighboring countries in the Gulf region. Iranian state media reported that the strikes caused injuries on the island of Qeshm and explosions in the province of Khuzestan. The IRGC also confirmed that three of its members were killed in the province of Zanjan.
paragraphs.zh: 最新的暴力事件始於美國對伊朗發動的一波猛烈空襲。根據美國中央司令部（US Central Command）的說法，這些攻擊鎖定了伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）的軍事指揮中心，以及其飛彈和無人機設施。美軍表示，這些行動對於降低伊朗對美國部隊、商船及波斯灣地區鄰國所構成的威脅是必要的。伊朗官媒報導稱，這些空襲導致格什姆島（Qeshm）有人員受傷，胡齊斯坦省（Khuzestan）也發生爆炸。革命衛隊亦證實，其三名成員在贊詹省（Zanjan）喪生。

paragraphs.en: These US strikes followed a period of intense pressure after Iran targeted a base in Jordan that hosts American troops. In response to the US attacks, Iran appears to have retaliated against American allies. Kuwait reported that an Iranian strike hit a building and killed one person, while Jordan reported incoming missiles for two days in a row. These events highlight how quickly the fighting can move from one country to another, involving multiple nations in the region.
paragraphs.zh: 在伊朗鎖定約旦境內駐有美軍的基地後，美國隨即發動了這些空襲，局勢一度陷入高度緊張。作為對美軍攻擊的回應，伊朗似乎對美國盟友展開了報復。科威特通報稱，伊朗的一次攻擊擊中了一棟建築並造成一人死亡；約旦則連續兩天通報遭到飛彈襲擊。這些事件凸顯了戰火如何在短時間內從一國蔓延至另一國，並將區域內多個國家捲入其中。

paragraphs.en: Iraq has found itself in the middle of this growing crisis. Earlier this week, the United States and Saudi Arabia conducted joint airstrikes against Iran-backed militias operating inside Iraq. These attacks resulted in the deaths of at least 20 fighters and six Iranian advisers. The Iraqi government reacted strongly to this news. Prime Minister Haider al-Aboudi decided to postpone a planned trip to Saudi Arabia because of the incident. A government spokesperson, Sabah al-Numan, stated that Baghdad had “no prior knowledge” of the attacks and did not give permission for them to happen on Iraqi territory.
paragraphs.zh: 伊拉克發現自己正處於這場日益嚴峻的危機中心。本週稍早，美國與沙烏地阿拉伯對在伊拉克境內活動的伊朗支持民兵發動了聯合空襲。這些攻擊造成至少二十名武裝分子與六名伊朗顧問死亡。伊拉克政府對此消息反應強烈，總理阿布迪（Haider al-Aboudi）決定推遲原定的沙烏地阿拉伯訪問行程。政府發言人努曼（Sabah al-Numan）表示，巴格達當局對於這些攻擊「事先毫無所悉」，且並未允許這些行動在伊拉克領土上發生。

paragraphs.en: There is also a clear disagreement regarding the cause of these tensions. Saudi Arabia recently claimed that drone strikes launched from Iraq had targeted its critical infrastructure. However, the Iraqi government has denied these claims, stating that no party has provided any evidence to support them. Iraqi officials have made it clear that they will not accept any one-sided actions—or unilateral actions—taken by foreign powers within their borders. At the same time, they insist that they will not allow their country to be used as a base for attacks against others.
paragraphs.zh: 對於這些緊張局勢的起因，各方也存在明顯分歧。沙烏地阿拉伯近期聲稱，從伊拉克發射的無人機攻擊了其關鍵基礎設施。然而，伊拉克政府否認了這些指控，表示沒有任何一方提供證據支持這些說法。伊拉克官員明確表示，他們不會接受外國勢力在其境內採取任何單方面行動。同時，他們也堅持不會允許國家被用作攻擊他國的基地。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the fighting in Iraq and Iran, the conflict is affecting other parts of the region. In Egypt, drone strikes caused fires on two natural gas vessels at the port of Damietta. While it is not yet clear who was responsible for these specific attacks, the incident marks the first time Egypt has been involved in the conflict since it began in late February. When asked if Iran was behind the incident, US President Donald Trump simply described it as “a little more of the same” and promised that the US would continue to hit back hard.
paragraphs.zh: 除了伊拉克與伊朗境內的戰鬥外，衝突也影響了該地區的其他部分。在埃及，無人機攻擊導致達米埃塔港（Damietta）的兩艘天然氣運輸船起火。雖然目前尚不清楚是誰應為這些特定攻擊負責，但此事件標誌著埃及自二月下旬衝突爆發以來，首次被捲入其中。當被問及伊朗是否為幕後黑手時，美國總統川普（Donald Trump）僅簡單形容這是「同樣戲碼的延續」，並承諾美國將持續強力反擊。

paragraphs.en: Despite the return to violence, international mediators are still trying to bring the two sides back to the negotiating table. A spokesperson for the Pakistani foreign ministry, Tahir Andrabi, stated that they are doing their “utmost” to restart talks. However, the recent exchange of strikes has made the diplomatic process much more difficult. The ongoing conflict has already caused significant problems for the world economy, and there is growing concern about how long this situation can continue before it causes even greater damage.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管暴力衝突重啟，國際調停者仍試圖讓雙方重回談判桌。巴基斯坦外交部發言人安德拉比（Tahir Andrabi）表示，他們正「竭盡全力」重啟對話。然而，近期頻繁的空襲交換使外交進程變得更加困難。持續的衝突已對全球經濟造成重大問題，且外界日益擔憂，若此情況持續下去，恐將造成更嚴重的損害。

paragraphs.en: In a separate development, President Trump announced that his “Board of Peace” has reached an agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas in Gaza. Disarmament is the process of taking away weapons from armed groups. Trump described this as a “major milestone” in his plan to end the war in Gaza. He explained that the agreement would happen in phases, eventually leading to the withdrawal of Israeli forces and the creation of a new Palestinian police force. While this announcement is a significant claim, it remains to be seen how it will be carried out or how it might affect the broader tensions between the US and Iran.
paragraphs.zh: 在另一項發展中，川普總統宣布他的「和平委員會」已達成一項協議，將徹底解除加薩走廊（Gaza）哈瑪斯（Hamas）的武裝。解除武裝是指從武裝團體手中收繳武器的過程。川普將此描述為他終結加薩戰爭計畫中的「重大里程碑」。他解釋說，該協議將分階段進行，最終目標是讓以色列軍隊撤離，並建立一支新的巴勒斯坦警察部隊。雖然這項宣布是一項重大聲明，但其具體執行方式，以及對美伊之間更廣泛緊張局勢的影響，仍有待觀察。

paragraphs.en: As the situation stands, the region remains on edge. The combination of direct military strikes, retaliatory attacks, and the involvement of multiple countries has created a complex web of conflict. With diplomatic efforts currently stalled, the world is watching closely to see if the parties can find a way to stop the fighting before it spreads any further.
paragraphs.zh: 就目前情況而言，該地區仍處於緊繃狀態。直接軍事打擊、報復性攻擊以及多國捲入的綜合因素，構成了一張複雜的衝突網。隨著外交努力目前陷入停滯，全世界正密切關注各方是否能在戰火進一步蔓延前，找到停止衝突的方法。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Tense, nervous, or anxious because of a difficult situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語形容處於高度緊張狀態，而非字面上的「在邊緣」。文中：As the situation stands, the region remains on edge.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop making progress or to be delayed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指車輛引擎熄火或停滯，此處指外交談判進展停擺。文中：With diplomatic efforts currently stalled, the world is watching closely to see if the parties can find a way to stop the fighting before it spreads any further.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To attack or criticize someone who has attacked or criticized you.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見的動詞片語，用於描述軍事或口頭上的報復。文中：When asked if Iran was behind the incident, US President Donald Trump simply described it as “a little more of the same” and promised that the US would continue to hit back hard.

This military action resulted in at least 20 deaths and followed a series of missile attacks by Iran against US forces in Jordan. The Iraqi government has strongly condemned the strikes, calling them a violation of its national sovereignty. Meanwhile, concerns are growing about the safety of oil shipping routes in the region. Analysts warn that the conflict is entering a dangerous and unpredictable new stage.

quiz.question: According to the article, what was the specific outcome of the joint airstrikes conducted by the United States and Saudi Arabia in Iraq?

options.A: The Iraqi government gave permission for the attacks to proceed.
options.B: At least 20 fighters and six Iranian advisers were killed.
options.C: The Iraqi Prime Minister traveled to Saudi Arabia to discuss the incident.
options.D: The strikes targeted the Iraqi government’s military command centers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段明確指出，美沙聯軍在伊拉克境內的空襲造成了至少 20 名武裝人員與 6 名伊朗顧問死亡。選項 A 錯誤，因為伊拉克政府發言人表示他們對此毫無所悉且未授權；選項 C 錯誤，因為總理反而因為此事取消了訪問行程；選項 D 錯誤，因為攻擊目標是伊朗支持的民兵，而非伊拉克政府軍的指揮中心。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the Iraqi government's position regarding the conflict?

options.A: Iraq is actively supporting Iran's military retaliation against the US.
options.B: Iraq is eager to host foreign military bases to ensure its own security.
options.C: Iraq is struggling to maintain its sovereignty while being caught between foreign powers.
options.D: Iraq is the primary orchestrator of the drone strikes against Saudi Arabia.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。從第四段與第五段可知，伊拉克政府既不滿美沙聯軍未經許可在其境內發動攻擊，又否認了沙烏地阿拉伯指控其境內發射無人機的說法，並強調不允許國家被當作攻擊他人的基地。這顯示出伊拉克正試圖在強權衝突中捍衛主權，卻深陷困境。選項 A、B、D 皆與文中伊拉克政府表達的立場或否認的內容相矛盾。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, the author describes the conflict as a 'complex web.' What does 'web' mean in this context?

options.A: A physical structure made by spiders.
options.B: A complicated system of interconnected elements.
options.C: A digital network used for military communication.
options.D: A trap designed to capture enemy soldiers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此文中，「web」被用來比喻衝突的本質，指涉多個國家、多種攻擊手段與外交僵局交織在一起的複雜局面，並非指實體的蜘蛛網或軍事陷阱。選項 A 是字面意義，不符合語境；選項 C 與 D 雖然聽起來與軍事有關，但文中並未提及任何數位網路或特定陷阱，故皆為錯誤選項。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The US and Iran have successfully reached a peace agreement through Pakistani mediation.
options.B: The conflict between the US and Iran is expanding regionally and becoming increasingly difficult to manage.
options.C: The most significant development in the conflict is the disarmament of Hamas in Gaza.
options.D: Saudi Arabia is the main country responsible for the recent escalation of violence.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章開頭提到衝突進入「危險的新階段」，隨後透過多個段落描述戰火如何蔓延至伊拉克、約旦、科威特與埃及，並指出外交努力受阻，整體論述的核心在於強調衝突的擴大化與複雜化。選項 A 與事實不符；選項 C 僅是文章末段提到的個別發展，非文章主旨；選項 D 僅是衝突參與方之一，非文章探討的核心議題。
